cohort: 27 women diagnosed with PAS between January 2019 and June 2021 at a tertiary center in Sri Lanka
finding: PAS is associated with long-term physical and psychological morbidity, and continuous support may help alleviate the psychological trauma.
followup_time: Varied, but IES-R and SF-36 questionnaires were administered, and the time since surgery was correlated with SF-36 domains
